message: Loading the stylesheet 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gridjs@5.0.2/dist/theme/mermaid.min.css".
